blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Custom Home Cost in Southbank, Melbourne?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the real cost of building a luxury custom home in Southbank, including factors like design, materials, council fees, and fixed-price contracts from Luxform Built.
body: Building a custom home in Southbank is an exciting journey, but one of the first questions every client asks is: 'How much will it cost?' The answer depends on several factors including the size of the home, the complexity of the design, and the finishes you choose. In Melbourne's inner suburbs, luxury custom homes typically range from $1,500 to $3,000 per square metre, with high-end projects often exceeding that. Southbank's premium location and council requirements can also influence the final figure.

Luxform Built specialises in fixed-price contracts, which means you'll know the total cost before construction begins. We provide a detailed tender quote after the design phase, breaking down every element from structural work to joinery and landscaping. This transparency ensures there are no surprises along the way. Our process includes a thorough feasibility check at the start, covering site conditions, zoning, and any heritage overlays that might apply in Southbank or nearby suburbs.

Design fees typically account for 8–12% of the total build cost. This includes architectural drawings, engineering, and interior design consultations. At Luxform Built, we work closely with trusted architects and consultants to ensure your vision aligns with your budget. We recommend setting aside a contingency of 10–15% for unforeseen site conditions, especially in older Southbank areas where underground services or soil issues can arise.

Council fees and permits are another significant cost. In Southbank, you'll need a building permit from the City of Melbourne, which can cost between $2,000 and $10,000 depending on the project's scope. Additionally, if your home is in a heritage overlay, you may require a heritage impact assessment. Our team handles all council liaison as part of our service, saving you time and stress.

Material choices greatly affect the final price. For luxury homes, clients often opt for natural stone benchtops, solid timber floors, custom cabinetry, and high-end appliances. These can add 30–50% compared to standard finishes. Luxform Built sources premium materials directly from trusted suppliers, and we provide clear options at every stage so you can balance quality with cost.

Labour costs in Melbourne remain competitive, but skilled trades are in high demand. We employ qualified carpenters, plasterers, and finishers who take pride in their work. Our fixed-price contracts protect you from price fluctuations in materials or labour. When you build with Luxform Built, you get a comprehensive warranty and ongoing support after handover, ensuring your investment is protected for years to come.

blogPosts.title: How to Choose a Luxury Home Builder in Melbourne's Inner Suburbs
blogPosts.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to selecting the right builder for your luxury home or renovation in Southbank, East Melbourne, and beyond — from checking licences to reviewing past projects.
body: Choosing the right builder for your luxury home is one of the most important decisions you'll make. In Melbourne's inner suburbs like Southbank, East Melbourne, and South Yarra, the market is filled with options but not all builders are equal. Start by checking their licence and insurance. Every builder in Victoria must hold a registered building practitioner licence. Luxform Built is fully licensed and insured, providing peace of mind from day one.

Look at their portfolio of completed projects. A reputable builder will have a range of homes that showcase their craftsmanship. For luxury builds, you want to see attention to detail in joinery, finishes, and spatial planning. Ask for references and take the time to speak with past clients. Our clients often highlight our communication, transparency, and the personal involvement of the founders in every project.

Consider their experience with projects similar to yours. If you're renovating a heritage home in East Melbourne, you need a builder who understands heritage overlays and traditional construction methods. Richard Caruso's background in heritage renovations makes Luxform Built an ideal partner for such projects. For modern custom homes, Jacob Sheehan's experience with complex architectural details ensures precision.

Transparency in pricing is critical. Avoid builders who provide vague estimates or refuse to give a fixed quote. At Luxform Built, we provide a detailed fixed tender quote after the design phase. This includes a breakdown of costs for each trade, materials, and contingency. We believe in no hidden fees and clear communication throughout the build.

Meet the team in person. A luxury build is a collaborative process that can last many months. You need to feel comfortable with the builder and trust their advice. Our founders are directly involved in every project, from the initial meeting to the final walk-through. We take the time to understand your lifestyle, preferences, and budget before we start.

Finally, check their industry affiliations and warranties. Membership in the Master Builders Association and proper warranties demonstrate a commitment to professionalism. Luxform Built offers a comprehensive warranty on all workmanship and materials, and we stand behind every home we build. By following these steps, you'll find a builder who delivers quality, integrity, and a home you'll love for decades.

blogPosts.title: The Complete Guide to Heritage Home Renovations in East Melbourne
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything you need to know about renovating a heritage home in East Melbourne, including council approvals, period-appropriate materials, and working with a specialist builder like Luxform Built.
body: Renovating a heritage home in East Melbourne is both a privilege and a challenge. These beautiful period properties require careful planning to preserve their character while introducing modern amenities. East Melbourne is known for its Victorian and Edwardian terraces, many of which are covered by heritage overlays. Any renovation must respect the original fabric and comply with strict council guidelines.

The first step is understanding your property's heritage status. Contact the City of Melbourne to check if your home is individually listed or part of a heritage precinct. You may need a heritage impact statement from a qualified professional. Luxform Built has extensive experience navigating these approvals, and we work with heritage consultants to ensure your renovation meets all requirements.

When it comes to materials, authenticity matters. Original features such as cornices, ceiling roses, leadlight windows, and timber floorboards should be restored where possible. For additions, we recommend sympathetic materials like recycled bricks, slate roofing, and timber sash windows. Modern elements like underfloor heating and ducted air-conditioning can be discreetly integrated without compromising the home's heritage value.

The structural challenges of heritage homes often include uneven floors, rising damp, and outdated wiring. A thorough structural assessment before starting is essential. Luxform Built's team includes carpenters skilled in traditional techniques, so we can repair and reinforce original timber frames while preserving their integrity. We also handle asbestos removal safely and in compliance with regulations.

Kitchens and bathrooms are where many heritage renovations see the biggest changes. Our approach is to create functional, modern spaces that feel like a natural part of the home. We use custom joinery that mirrors the period style, with shaker cabinets, brass fixtures, and butler sinks. Stone benchtops and modern appliances are carefully chosen to blend seamlessly.

The result is a home that retains its original charm but lives comfortably for today's family. Heritage renovations typically take 6 to 12 months depending on scope. Luxform Built manages every stage with a detailed timeline and regular updates. We're proud to have transformed many East Melbourne homes into beautiful, liveable spaces that honour their history.

blogPosts.title: Luxury Apartment Renovation in Southbank: What to Expect
blogPosts.excerpt: Thinking of renovating your Southbank apartment? This guide covers everything from body corporate approvals to premium finishes, timelines, and working with Luxform Built.
body: Southbank is home to some of Melbourne's most prestigious apartment buildings, and renovating a luxury apartment comes with its own set of rules and opportunities. Whether you're updating a kitchen, bathroom, or doing a full fit-out, you'll need to navigate body corporate regulations, building managers, and strict noise restrictions. Luxform Built has extensive experience in apartment renovations across Southbank and Docklands.

The first step is obtaining approval from your owners corporation. Most buildings require a detailed renovation application, including plans, insurance certificates, and a timeline of works. We handle all the paperwork and liaise directly with the building manager to ensure everything is approved before we start. Some buildings have restricted working hours, which we factor into our schedule.

Luxury apartment renovations focus on maximising space and light. Southbank apartments often feature floor-to-ceiling windows and open-plan layouts. Our designs enhance these features with minimal structural changes. For example, we can install custom joinery that integrates storage seamlessly, upgrade lighting to smart systems, and replace flooring with premium timber or stone.

High-end finishes define a luxury renovation. Popular choices include marble benchtops, Miele appliances, custom cabinetry with soft-close mechanisms, and feature wall tiles in bathrooms. We source materials from leading suppliers and offer samples so you can see and feel the quality before committing. Our fixed-price quote covers everything, so there are no surprise costs.

Timelines for apartment renovations are typically shorter than houses — often 4 to 8 weeks for a kitchen or bathroom, and up to 12 weeks for a full fit-out. We work efficiently to minimise disruption and keep the worksite clean and secure. Our team is experienced in working in occupied buildings, coordinating with building management for deliveries and waste removal.

The result is a transformed living space that reflects your style and meets the highest standards of luxury living. Whether you're preparing to sell or creating your dream home, a well-executed renovation adds significant value. Luxform Built has completed numerous apartment projects in Southbank, and our clients appreciate the care, communication, and quality we bring to every project.
